lines.en: label undeservedfuture12:
scene shiori1
: Is {i}that{/i} why I need to work today? Because you were slacking off in your little pocket dimension again?
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}这就是我今天得干活的原因？因为你又在你的小口袋次元里摸鱼了？

lines.en: : No. You need to work today because I have made a grave mistake. That mistake just happens to involve said pocket dimension and you’re the only person I can rely on.
lines.zh: : 不是。你今天得干活，是因为我犯了一个严重的错误。这个错误刚好就涉及那个口袋次元，而你是我唯一能依靠的人。

lines.en: scene shiori2
: Please don’t rely on me. Who is this and why is he conscious?
lines.zh: : 求你别依靠我。这位是谁，他为什么是清醒的？

lines.en: : That’s my dad! Dad, Shiori. Shiori, Dad.
lines.zh: : 那是我爸爸！爸爸，这是 Shiori。Shiori，这是我爸爸。

lines.en: : Uhh...nice to meet you?
lines.zh: : 呃……幸会？

lines.en: : Doumo.
lines.zh: : Doumo.

lines.en: scene shiori3
: You have {i}royally{/i} fucked up, Himawari. Surely you understand that without me having to tell you, right?
lines.zh: : 你这次是{i}真的{/i}搞砸了，Himawari。不用我说你肯定也明白，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s why I said you’re the only person I can rely on! You’re the only one who won’t tell on me!
lines.zh: : 所以我说你是我唯一能依靠的人啊！你是唯一一个不会去打小报告的人！

lines.en: : I assume it’s frowned upon to take your father with you on a job like this?
lines.zh: : 我猜，干这种活还带着自己爸爸，是不太被允许的吧？

lines.en: scene shiori4
: That’s putting it lightly. {i}Extremely{/i} lightly. But it’s not like this girl has ever followed the rules in the first place, so I can’t say it’s unexpected.
lines.zh: : 这话说得太轻了。轻得{i}不能再{/i}轻。不过这姑娘本来就没守过规矩，所以我也不好说这出乎意料。

lines.en: : I follow some of them! Just...you know, not the ones that potentially interfere with both my loved ones and myself. Which is why I told him basically everything about this place.
lines.zh: : 我守了其中一部分！只是……你知道，那些可能妨害到我和我所爱的人的规矩没守。所以我基本上把这里的一切都告诉他了。

lines.en: : What was wrong with this one again? You talk about it so much that I blocked it from my memory. All I remember is you’re not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 这个世界的问题又是什么来着？你念叨太多次，我都把它从记忆里屏蔽了。我只记得你不该在这儿。

lines.en: : It’s the one that shouldn’t have ever existed in the first place. With that Maya girl who-
lines.zh: : 就是那个一开始就不该存在的世界。跟那个叫 Maya 的女孩——

lines.en: : Oh, right. The unstable one where everyone’s super horny all the time. No wonder I never come here.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。那个不稳定的、所有人一天到晚都在发情的世界。怪不得我从不来这儿。

lines.en: scene shiori5
: But you’re here today! Which means you can help us get everything in order before we turn the clock back. Right?
lines.zh: : 可你今天来了！也就是说你能帮我们在把时钟拨回去之前把一切都收拾妥当。对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know. How badly are you going to annoy me if I back out now?
lines.zh: : 我可说不好。如果我现在退出，你会烦我到什么程度？

lines.en: : That really hinges on whether or not I continue to exist. There’s a solid chance I just disappear for good if he stays here as it would disrupt the-
lines.zh: : 这主要取决于我还能不能继续存在。如果他留在这儿，我很有可能会彻底消失，因为那会打乱——

lines.en: scene shiori6
: What’s your name?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字？

lines.en: : At least {i}pretend{/i} to be worried about me! Or, at the very least, let me finish my speech.
lines.zh: : 你至少{i}假装{/i}担心我一下吧！再不济，也让我把话说完。

lines.en: : Akira Arakawa.
lines.zh: : Akira Arakawa.

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Why? Have you...heard it before?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你……以前听过吗？

lines.en: scene shiori7
: No. I just half-expected {i}your{/i} name to be stupid too since you named your daughter “Himawari.” Akira’s pretty normal though. It’s fitting for someone so ordinary looking.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是因为你给女儿起名叫「Himawari」，我有点预期{i}你的{/i}名字也会很蠢。不过 Akira 还挺正常的。倒是很配你这张普通脸。

lines.en: : I’m actually a little glad my mom couldn’t come with us. The idea of you insulting my entire family in one fell swoop makes me angry.
lines.zh: : 说实话我还有点庆幸妈妈没能一起来。一想到你一口气把我全家都侮辱一遍，我就来气。

lines.en: scene shiori8
: So, where am I going? How many are there and how many have you found so far?
lines.zh: : 那么，我要去哪儿？总共有多少人，你目前找到多少了？

lines.en: : One male and thirty-four females total. I’ve only tackled one so far. That number includes Maya, though. And she’s a little harder to take care of than-
lines.zh: : 总共一名男性、三十四名女性。我目前只处理了一个。不过这个数字里包含 Maya。而她处理起来要比——难一点。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me how to do my job. I’ve been at this longer than you’ve been alive.
lines.zh: : 别教我怎么干活。我干这行的时间比你活着的年头都长。

lines.en: : And how long is that exactly?
lines.zh: : 那具体是多久？

lines.en: scene shiori9
: Good luck. She won’t even tell {i}me{/i} and I’m practically her best friend. Just look at how long I’ve been touching her without being swatted away.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。她连{i}我{/i}都不告诉，而我基本上算是她最好的朋友了。你看我都摸了她这么久还没被拍开呢。

lines.en: : A long time. And I have no reason to tell someone I just met, so leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 很久。而且我没有理由告诉一个刚认识的人，所以到此为止。

lines.en: : Shiori-Senpai might seem cold, but don’t worry. She’ll put just as much love and care into fixing everyone as me.
lines.zh: : Shiori 前辈看着是挺冷，不过别担心。她修好每个人时投入的爱和用心，不会比我少。

lines.en: : If you trust her, I trust her. And if there’s any way I can help, don’t hesitate to let me know.
lines.zh: : 你信任她，我就信任她。如果有任何我能帮上忙的地方，别犹豫，尽管说。

lines.en: : If you really want to help, go hide somewhere until we’re done here. Because, no offense, but all you’re going to do is get in Himawari’s way.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想帮忙，就找个地方躲着，等我们忙完。因为，无意冒犯，但你能做的只有碍 Himawari 的事。

lines.en: scene shiori10
: Shi-chan, that’s not-
lines.zh: : Shi 酱，那不——

lines.en: : I mean emotionally.
lines.zh: : 我是说情感上。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll finish the job regardless of whether or not he’s here, but I don’t think you’re mentally strong enough to do this alongside someone so important to you.
lines.zh: : 我确信不管他在不在，你都会把活干完。但我不觉得你有足够强的心理素质，能在一个对你这么重要的人旁边做这件事。

lines.en: : Nor do I think {i}he{/i} needs a behind the scenes tour of what we do. It’s not like that’s going to help him get out.
lines.zh: : 我也不认为{i}他{/i}需要幕后参观我们做的事。那又帮不了他出去。

lines.en: : You’re letting your emotions light the way again. I told you that you can’t do that if you really want to survive here.
lines.zh: : 你又让情绪替你照路了。我说过，如果你真想在这儿活下去，就不能这样。

lines.en: scene shiori11
: Also, stop calling me Shi-chan. I hate nicknames.
lines.zh: : 还有，别叫我 Shi 酱。我讨厌昵称。

lines.en: : You hate everything. I never have any idea what I’m supposed to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 你什么都讨厌。我从来不知道该跟你聊什么。

lines.en: : Probably because you aren’t supposed to be talking to me at all. We’re supposed to do our jobs and that’s it. We didn’t sign up for this to make friends.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你本来就不该跟我说话。我们该做的就是干活，仅此而已。我们签这个约可不是为了交朋友。

lines.en: : Why {i}did{/i} you sign up then?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}当初{/i}为什么签约？

lines.en: scene shiori12
: And that’s not me trying to be facetious. I just...genuinely don’t understand your role or job or {i}anything.{/i} Like {i}why{/i} do you do this? There needs to be some sort of benefit, right?
lines.zh: : 我不是在抬杠。我只是……真的不理解你的角色、你的工作，{i}什么都不{/i}理解。比如你{i}为什么{/i}要干这个？总得有什么好处吧？

lines.en: : Is the pay just {i}that{/i} good? Or...do you get something {i}else{/i} out of it? I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 是薪水{i}特别{/i}高吗？还是……你能从中得到{i}别的{/i}什么？我不明白。

lines.en: : Good. Things are better off that way.
lines.zh: : 很好。这样更好。

lines.en: scene shiori13

: That said, if you {i}really{/i} want to be helpful, go stand over there for a minute so I can talk to Himawari alone. I don’t want to accidentally short-circuit your brain in front of your daughter.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，如果你{i}真{/i}想帮忙，就去那边站一会儿，我好跟 Himawari 单独谈谈。我可不想在你女儿面前不小心把你脑子烧短路。

lines.en: : Just...over there? By myself?
lines.zh: : 就……站那边？我一个人？

lines.en: : Play with that girl’s corpse if you want to. She’s basically just a doll right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 想玩那姑娘的尸体也随你。反正她现在基本就是个人偶。

lines.en: : Don’t give him any ideas. This is a weird world for him and he is a creature of habit.
lines.zh: : 别给他出主意。这个世界对他来说已经够怪了，而他又是个习惯成自然的生物。

lines.en: scene black
I walk past Sana’s body on the way to the shoreline and try to spot any signs of breathing, knowing I’m better off thinking of {i}her{/i} rather than trying to eavesdrop right now.
lines.zh: 我走向海岸线时从 Sana 的身体旁走过，试图找出任何呼吸的迹象——我知道此刻与其试着偷听，不如想着{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: Unfortunately, as I look off toward the horizon, I think not of the stars or how they mimic the web this world has spun. But I {i}do{/i} think of the latest bipedal mystery to appear before me.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，当我望向地平线时，我想到的不是星星，也不是它们如何映照出这个世界织出的网。我想到的，{i}是{/i}刚出现在我面前的那个最新的双足谜团。

lines.en: And how all I can do is hope that Himawari can handle her a little better than I could ever wish to.
lines.zh: 而我所能做的，只有祈祷 Himawari 能比我更应付得了她。

lines.en: scene shiori14
: Question. Have you lost your fucking mind?
lines.zh: : 问一句。你是不是他妈的疯了？

lines.en: : Maybe. Probably.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。大概是。

lines.en: : Did I not get it across to you just how serious it is to leave people like him out of this?
lines.zh: : 我是不是没说清楚，把像他这样的人排除在外有多严重？

lines.en: : You can’t {i}guide{/i} him. No matter {i}how{/i} badly you want him to succeed. No matter {i}what{/i} rides on that success.
lines.zh: : 你不能{i}引导{/i}他。不管你{i}多{/i}想让他成功。不管那成功牵系着{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : All it takes is one look from the higher-ups, who are {i}already{/i} suspicious of you, to put an end to not just {i}your{/i} family, but everyone’s.
lines.zh: : 只要上层——他们{i}已经{/i}对你起了疑心——看上一眼，就足以终结的不仅仅是{i}你的{/i}家人，还有所有人的。

lines.en: : This entire world and all that run parallel to it are now at risk, Himawari. You could all be gone by daylight and no one would ever know.
lines.zh: : 整个世界以及所有与它平行的世界现在都处在风险之中，Himawari。天亮之前你们可能就全没了，而且没人会知道。

lines.en: : And now {i}I’m{/i} at risk since you’ve dragged me into this mess too. Do you think I {i}want{/i} to die?
lines.zh: : 现在连{i}我{/i}也处在风险里了，因为你也把我拖进了这摊烂事。你觉得我{i}想{/i}死吗？

lines.en: : Sometimes, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有时候，是啊。

lines.en: : Everybody wants to die {i}sometimes.{/i} That means nothing. You get what I’m saying, though. And you’re {i}smarter{/i} than this. So stop trying to play God and let him figure it out on his own.
lines.zh: : 每个人都有想死的{i}时候{/i}。那说明不了什么。不过你懂我的意思。而且你比这{i}聪明{/i}。所以别再扮演上帝了，让他自己去想明白。

lines.en: : I don’t know if he will, Senpai. And I know exactly what I’m risking by doing this. It doesn’t change anything.
lines.zh: : 我不知道他会不会，前辈。而且我清楚地知道自己这么做在拿什么冒险。这改变不了什么。

lines.en: scene shiori15
: Well, so long as you {i}know{/i} you’re being an irresponsible idiot, there’s not much else I can do. It’s not like I’m going to stop you myself.
lines.zh: : 好吧，既然你{i}知道{/i}自己是个不负责任的白痴，那我也没什么别的办法了。反正我也不会亲自去拦你。

lines.en: scene shiori16
: I just hope you’re prepared for what comes next.
lines.zh: : 我只希望你对接下来要发生的事有所准备。

lines.en: : Because {i}you’re{/i} barely any different from that wish girl by interfering to this extent. You’re turning this world into {i}your{/i} sandbox instead of theirs.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}你{/i}干预到这个程度，跟那个愿望女孩也差不了多少。你正在把这个世界变成{i}你的{/i}沙盒，而不是她们的。

lines.en: : You already have a world. Go play there. Leave this one to those who can actually do something with it.
lines.zh: : 你已经有了一个世界了。去那儿玩吧。把这个留给那些真正能拿它做点什么的人。

lines.en: : No one’s doing {i}anything{/i} with it, though. It’s just suffering...day after day after day. And the longer it goes on, the uglier everything will be when this place collapses.
lines.zh: : 可是没人对它做{i}任何事{/i}啊。只有苦难……日复一日，日复一日。而拖得越久，这个地方崩塌时一切就会变得越难看。

lines.en: : I just want to see them be happy. I want my family to be a family. Is that really too much to ask?
lines.zh: : 我只是想看到她们幸福。我想让我的家人成为真正的家人。这真的过分吗？

lines.en: : You’ve already asked that and you’ve already received an answer. And you can go there whenever you want, which is far more than most can do. So why hurt yourself like this?
lines.zh: : 你已经问过了，也已经得到答案了。而且你随时都能去那儿，这远比大多数人能做到的多得多。那你为什么还要这样伤害自己？

lines.en: : Because it’s not fair if only {i}they’re{/i} hurting.
lines.zh: : 因为只有{i}她们{/i}在受苦，这不公平。

lines.en: scene shiori17
: Fucking empaths. You’re all so exhausting.
lines.zh: : 该死的共情者。你们一个个都累死人。

lines.en: : Shiori-Senpai, why do you always reset yourself?
lines.zh: : Shiori 前辈，你为什么总是重置自己？

lines.en: : This again? I already told you-
lines.zh: : 又来了？我不是说过——

lines.en: : I know you said that the job is easier when you’re numb, but don’t you think that outlook might change if you actually let yourself {i}feel?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道你说过，麻木一点活儿更好干。但你不觉得，如果你真的让自己去{i}感受{/i}，那种看法可能会改变吗？

lines.en: : Yes. You just answered your own question, so thanks. It saves me the work.
lines.zh: : 会。你刚自己回答了你的问题，谢谢。省得我费口舌了。

lines.en: : Is there really no one you want to save out there? No one that {i}you{/i} want to be with? {i}This{/i} you. Not the other ones.
lines.zh: : 外面真的没有你想拯救的人吗？没有{i}你{/i}想与之相伴的人吗？是{i}现在{/i}的你，不是那些别的你。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have to keep wiping my mind if there wasn’t. But that changes nothing, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 如果没有，我也就不用一直抹掉自己的记忆了。可那改变不了什么，Himawari。

lines.en: scene shiori18
: You want to make the world a better place, don’t you? That’s what you’re always daydreaming about when you’re not too busy bragging about your parents.
lines.zh: : 你想让世界变得更好，对吧？你没在忙着吹嘘你爸妈的时候，做白日梦想的就是这个。

lines.en: : How do you expect to do that when you’re putting so many people in danger by just {i}being{/i} here?
lines.zh: : 可你光是{i}待在{/i}这里就把这么多人置于危险之中，你还指望怎么做到？

lines.en: : I’ll figure it out. I just...need more time.
lines.zh: : 我会想出办法的。我只是……需要更多时间。

lines.en: : No. You need a lobotomy.
lines.zh: : 不。你需要的是脑叶切除术。

lines.en: scene shiori19
: I’ve said all I need to say, though. I just wanted to make sure you know how much of a reckless idiot you’re being right now.
lines.zh: : 不过该说的我都说了。我只是想让你清楚，你现在有多像个鲁莽的白痴。

lines.en: : Ready to get the ball rolling and probably traumatize your dad and ruin his life in ways you never expected to?
lines.zh: : 准备好开始干活了吗——顺便把你爸折腾出心理阴影，再用你从没预料到的方式毁掉他的人生？

lines.en: : I was kind of hoping you could handle all of the brutal stuff this time and leave the dolls to me. I told him that was your job because I didn’t want him to know I have to clean up viscera sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我其实有点希望这次那些血腥的活儿都由你来，人偶交给我。我跟他说那是你的工作，因为我不想让他知道我有时候还得清理内脏碎块。

lines.en: : Then you handle the beach and I’ll go scour the rest of the town. Are everyone’s profiles updated, at least?
lines.zh: : 那你负责海滩，我去把镇上其他地方搜一遍。至少每个人的档案都更新了吧？

lines.en: : I think so. I haven’t been the one doing it on account of, well...you know. {i}Suspicion.{/i}
lines.zh: : 应该是。不是我在做，因为……你知道的。{i}被人怀疑{/i}。

lines.en: scene shiori20
: I’m glad your brain is still {i}somewhat{/i} functional. One last thing before I go, though.
lines.zh: : 我很欣慰你的脑子{i}还算{/i}能转。不过我走之前还有最后一件事。

lines.en: : What is it?...I don’t know where anyone else is yet if that’s what you’re-
lines.zh: : 什么事？……如果你要问的是那个，我还不知道其他人在哪儿——

lines.en: : Just try to enjoy it, okay? It’s possible you never see him again after this.
lines.zh: : 尽量去享受吧，好吗？这之后你可能再也见不到他了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Shi-chan...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Shi 酱……

lines.en: : That really helps.
lines.zh: : 这真的很有用。

lines.en: : No problem.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: scene shiori21
: But stop fucking calling me Shi-chan.
lines.zh: : 但别他妈再叫我 Shi 酱了。

lines.en: scene shiori22
scene black
scene shiori23
: So, uhh...is she {i}always{/i} like that?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……她{i}一直{/i}都是这样吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s more or less Shiori-Senpai for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯。Shiori 前辈差不多就是这样。

lines.en: : A little rough around the edges, sure. But there’s some gap-moe there if you’re willing to dig deep enough.
lines.zh: : 边缘是粗糙了点，没错。不过只要你愿意往深了挖，还是有点反差萌的。

lines.en: : Can’t say I expected your first friend to be some goth girl. The two of you are practically polar opposites.
lines.zh: : 我可没想到你的第一个朋友会是个哥特少女。你们俩简直是两个极端。

lines.en: : I had plenty of friends back in Aomori. I just preferred hanging out with you guys.
lines.zh: : 我在 Aomori 的时候朋友多的是。我只是更喜欢跟你们俩待在一起。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is you’re a loser.
lines.zh: : 所以你是在说你是个废柴。

lines.en: : Guess so. Everybody always teased me for it back then too. It never really bothered me, though.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。那时候大家也总拿这个取笑我。不过我从来没真往心里去。

lines.en: scene shiori24
: To be honest, I’ve never really understood that whole “being embarrassed by your parents” thing that it seems like virtually every other teenager has to endure. Perhaps I am just broken?
lines.zh: : 说实话，我一直不太理解那种「为自己父母感到丢人」的事——看起来几乎每个别的青少年都得经历一遍。也许我只是坏掉了吧？

lines.en: : Perhaps. I’m not about to try and fix you, though.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过我可没打算试着修好你。

lines.en: scene shiori25
: Wow. That’s probably the first time you’ve said that about literally anybody.
lines.zh: : 哇。这大概是你第一次对任何人说出这种话。

lines.en: : I don’t think so, to be honest. I feel like my expectation going into a relationship is that I’m going to wind up damaging whoever’s unfortunate enough to engage in one with me.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不这么认为。我觉得我进入一段关系时的预期就是——我最终会伤害到那个不幸跟我交往的人。

lines.en: : Oooooh, so maybe it was {i}you{/i} who broke me! Nice. That means I don’t have to feel bad about myself anymore and I can just blame you instead.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，所以也许是你把我弄坏的！不错。那意味着我不用再为{i}自己{/i}难过了，直接怪你就行。

lines.en: scene shiori26
: It’s kind of funny, though. Because apart from expecting to be the one who hurts people, I also expect to be the one people want to fix. And I feel like, most of the time, that’s true.
lines.zh: : 不过这还挺好笑的。因为除了预期自己会是那个伤人的人，我也预期自己会是那个别人想修好的人。而且我觉得大多数时候确实如此。

lines.en: : But the only person to ever have any success with that is you, I think.
lines.zh: : 但我想，唯一在这方面成功过的人是你。

lines.en: : Wow. It’s almost as if spreading yourself between a million lovers is not a healthy decision. Who’d have thought?
lines.zh: : 哇。这倒像是说，把自己分散给一百万个情人不是什么健康的选择。谁想得到呢？

lines.en: : You know Ami’s basically my daughter too though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过你也知道，Ami 基本上也算我女儿吧？

lines.en: : I know she is {i}here.{/i} But maybe I just don’t really see her that way since she was just always “Aunt Ami” to me.
lines.zh: : 我知道她在{i}这儿{/i}算是。不过也许我只是没真的那么看她，因为对我来说她一直是「Ami 阿姨」。

lines.en: : And she was good to you? She never, like...hurt you? Or tried to influence you or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 那她对你好吗？她从来没有……伤害过你？或者试图影响你什么的？

lines.en: : Not once. I really liked her, to be honest. But I kept my distance since I know you and Mom were a little worried about her.
lines.zh: : 一次都没有。说实话我挺喜欢她的。不过我保持了距离，因为我知道你和妈妈对她有点担心。

lines.en: : And seeing how she is here? I completely get it.
lines.zh: : 而看到她在这儿的样子？我完全理解了。

lines.en: scene shiori27
: Everybody’s different here, though. Well...except for Mom, maybe. But I don’t even want to talk about how long it took for me to accept that you were just a bimbo back in the day.
lines.zh: : 不过这里每个人都不一样。嗯……也许除了妈妈。但我甚至不想提我花了多久才接受你当年就是个花瓶。

lines.en: : That was nothing like the you from my memories. So seeing you traipse all over town engaging in illicit affairs with girls my age was, uhhh...{i}kinda really gross.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那跟我记忆中的你完全不一样。所以看到你满镇子乱晃，跟我同龄的女孩搞不正当关系，呃……{i}真的挺恶心的{/i}。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m sorry you had to see that. If I knew-
lines.zh: : 是啊……我很抱歉你不得不看到那些。如果我知道——

lines.en: scene shiori28
: Don’t make it weird and apologize for doing stuff from before I was technically born. All that matters is you stopped once I {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 别搞得这么别扭，还为我出生之前你干的那些事道歉。唯一重要的是，我{i}出生{/i}之后你就停了。

lines.en: : Besides, expecting you to act all wholesome and chaste when you wished someone like Maya into existence is just flat-out unreasonable.
lines.zh: : 再说，你许愿要来 Maya 这样的人，还指望你表现得纯洁禁欲，本来就完全不合理。

lines.en: : I think I’ve just come to terms with your entire backstory being miserable and perverse by now. And with the help of parental controls, I am now mostly shielded from that!
lines.zh: : 我想我已经接受了你的整个过往又悲惨又变态这件事。而且多亏了家长控制，我现在大部分时候都能屏蔽掉那些了！

lines.en: : {i}Mostly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大部分？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s automated, unfortunately. Can’t expect filters like that to catch 100%% of everything. So I just always need to have a bottle of hand-sanitizer nearby so I can dump it into my eyes if I see something weird.
lines.zh: : 可惜是自动的。不能指望这种过滤器能拦下 100%% 的东西。所以我身边总得备一瓶免洗洗手液，万一看到什么奇怪的东西，就直接倒进眼睛里。

lines.en: scene shiori29
: This revelation will likely affect my life in a greater way than even meeting you did.
lines.zh: : 这个爆料对我人生的影响，大概比遇见你还要大。

lines.en: : You’ll cave and that’s not really something you should feel bad about. It’s a part of who you are and an obstacle to overcome.
lines.zh: : 你会破防的，而这其实没什么好自责的。那是你的一部分，也是需要跨越的障碍。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how tough that is when there’s a girl walking around who you essentially {i}created.{/i} In a way much different from how you created me, of course.
lines.zh: : 我只能想象那有多难——毕竟身边走着一个几乎算是你{i}创造出来{/i}的女孩。当然，这跟你创造我的方式大不相同。

lines.en: : Maya really is just the physical manifestation of your desire and temptation and pain all wrapped into one little codependent tsundere package, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : Maya 真的就是你的欲望、诱惑和痛苦的化身，全都打包进一个小小的、互相依赖的傲娇包裹里，不是吗？

lines.en: : She’s not all that tsundere nowadays. Lately, it’s more desperation than anything else.
lines.zh: : 她现在没那么傲娇了。最近更多是绝望，而不是别的什么。

lines.en: : I have no idea what I’m supposed to do, honestly.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我完全不知道我该怎么做。

lines.en: scene shiori30
: Because if this is {i}her{/i} world...and the only way to reunite with you is to somehow break it down, I...
lines.zh: : 因为如果这是{i}她{/i}的世界……而唯一能跟你重聚的办法就是想办法把它拆掉，我……

lines.en: : I {i}will{/i} do it. Of {i}course{/i} I’ll do it. But that doesn’t mean I’m going to long for a world where she doesn’t exist anymore. I want to keep her by any means possible.
lines.zh: : 我{i}会{/i}做的。我{i}当然{/i}会做。但那不意味着我会去向往一个她不再存在的世界。我想不惜一切把她留下。

lines.en: : {i}Any{/i} version of her. Because even if it’s not the one who most vividly exists in my memories, she still searched for me for {i}years.{/i} Far longer than you have, I imagine.
lines.zh: : 她的{i}任何{/i}版本都行。因为即使不是在我记忆里最鲜活的那一个，她也找了我{i}好多年{/i}。我想，比你要久得多。

lines.en: : {i}Far{/i} longer. I’m still new to this, all things considered. And I hope for your sake that I’m wrong and she {i}can{/i} come back with you if we wind up accomplishing our goal.
lines.zh: : {i}久{/i}得多。综合来看，我干这行还不久。而为了你，我希望我是错的，希望如果我们最终达成了目标，她{i}能{/i}跟你一起回去。

lines.en: : But again, if something seems like it’s too good to be true...
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，如果有什么事看起来好得不像真的……

lines.en: : It normally-
lines.zh: : 那通常——

lines.en: scene shiori31
scene shiori32
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : Making you love me more?
lines.zh: : 让你更爱我一点？

lines.en: : Himawari-
lines.zh: : Himawari——

lines.en: : It’s a roleplaying exercise!
lines.zh: : 这是角色扮演练习！

lines.en: : I’ve learned recently that my Maya impression needs some work. And {i}you{/i} don’t yet know how to talk to her about all of this. So now we can both practice!
lines.zh: : 我最近发现我的 Maya 模仿还需要练练。而{i}你{/i}还不知道该怎么跟她谈这些事。所以现在我们可以一起练习！

lines.en: : You are my daughter and I do not want you wearing the clothes of the girl I created to sate the most evil of lusts that has ever existed. Change back.
lines.zh: : 你是我女儿，我不希望你穿着那个我为满足世上最邪恶的欲望而创造出来的女孩的衣服。换回去。

lines.en: scene shiori33
: But Halloween is right around the corner and I never get to dress up for it!
lines.zh: : 可是万圣节马上就到了，而我从没机会为它打扮过！

lines.en: : Himawari...
lines.zh: : Himawari……

lines.en: scene shiori34
: That’s Hima-chan to you, Master. I am a maid now.
lines.zh: : 请叫我 Hima 酱，Master。我现在是女仆了。

lines.en: : Does making the most of what time we have left really just translate to you tormenting me for the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 充分利用我们剩下的时间，意思就是你要折磨我一整天吗？

lines.en: scene shiori35
: No, but that’s what being your daughter translates to. Annoying you is my god-given right. I just hope it’s one of the {i}cool{/i} gods and not a weird, scary one.
lines.zh: : 不是，但「当你女儿」就是这个意思。烦你是我神赐的权利。我只希望那是个{i}酷{/i}神，不是什么又怪又吓人的神。

lines.en: : Do I have the god-given right as your father to ground you if you don’t listen to me?
lines.zh: : 那么作为你父亲，如果你不听话，我也有神赐的权利禁足你吗？

lines.en: : Only if you want to get another visit from CPS.
lines.zh: : 只要你不怕 CPS 再上门一次。

lines.en: scene black
: If everything else about the way you speak and act and look didn’t scream that you’re the same Himawari from Aomori, that right there would have done it immediately.
lines.zh: : 如果你说话、举止和长相上的一切都还没在尖叫着说明你就是 Aomori 的那个 Himawari，光是这句话就立刻够了。

lines.en: : Now put your regular clothes back on. I don’t want you dressed as a maid either.
lines.zh: : 现在把你平时的衣服穿回来。我也不想看你穿女仆装。

lines.en: : I actually wore something similar a long time ago and appeared to you while you were on a date. You said I was very attractive and I immediately regretted my decision.
lines.zh: : 其实很久以前我穿过类似的衣服，在你约会的时候出现在你面前。你说我非常有魅力，然后我立刻就后悔了自己的决定。

lines.en: : Please forget that ever happened. I am so sorry.
lines.zh: : 请忘了那件事吧。我非常抱歉。

lines.en: : I can guarantee you that I want nothing more than to forget it happened as well, Dad.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我也同样恨不得把那件事忘掉，爸爸。

lines.en: : Then why are you still dressed as a maid?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还穿着女仆装？

lines.en: : I transformed too many times and the spell is on cooldown now. I {i}am{/i} technically a magical girl, you know. There are rules that govern our powers.
lines.zh: : 我变身太多次，咒语现在进入冷却了。严格来说我也{i}算是{/i}个魔法少女，你知道吗。我们的力量是受规则约束的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I’d like to see that rule book when you get a chance.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那你有机会的话给我看看那本规则书。
